read_yaml_to_configs: create a function that reads a YAML file and returns a dict of DatasetConf objects keyed by dataset name
create_DatasetConf: create a DatasetConf dataclass instance with name, annotation, and optional root_dir fields
review_DatasetConf: review the DatasetConf dataclass and its name, annotation, and root_dir fields
summarize_read_yaml_to_configs: summarize the read_yaml_to_configs function that parses YAML into DatasetConf objects
test_read_yaml_to_configs: test the read_yaml_to_configs function by passing a YAML file path and checking returned configs
